policy: LRU; 16 slots match the 16-slot meta batch; do not flatten to a 1 GiB VM
note: Host transports page bytes and vectors only; the native opcode122 head block performs QKV/MLP arithmetic in the guest.

native_block.architecture: single-token 128D three-layer bf16 QKV/MLP head block
native_block.attention: single-token local attention is exactly V; Q/K weights are evaluated but do not change the one-token context
native_block.note: The guest validates the page header and performs all bf16 decode, LayerNorm, matvec, tanh, attention and residual updates.
